name: Gunslinger
description: A master of firearms, the Gunslinger dominates the battlefield with precision, speed, and devastating firepower. Their bullets are an extension of their will, and no enemy is safe from their sights.
prerequisite: At least two Tier 2 or Tier 3 Marksman Techniques
achievement: Land 25+ critical hits using firearms (pistols, rifles, or shotguns)
Complete a mission using only firearms (no melee weapons)
Successfully eliminate a high-value target in a single shot during a mission (e.g., headshot a boss enemy)

abilities.name: Quickdraw
abilities.effect: Gain +1d8 bonus to Attack Dice when attacking first in combat or during ambushes. Drawing or holstering firearms no longer costs Stamina. For 2 Reflex, you may interrupt an enemy’s attack by shooting their weapon out of their hand (Opposed Roll: Attack Dice vs. Reaction Dice).

abilities.name: Trick Shot
abilities.effect: When you hit with a ranged attack using a pistol or rifle, ricochet bullets off surfaces, hitting up to 2 additional targets within line of sight for half damage. If the ricocheted attack rolls a critical hit, deal full damage instead.

abilities.name: Bullet Time
abilities.effect: Slow time for yourself: replenish all Reflex and take two Turns back-to-back before passing Momentum.

abilities.name: Deadeye
abilities.effect: Empty your magazine to attack all enemies within your weapon's range. Roll 1d12 for each bullet fired; each roll of 5+ hits a target, and each roll of 8+ deals critical damage. If you roll a natural 12 on this attack, reload your weapon instantly without spending Stamina.
